caption: The drawing features three representations of a bowl on a plain, off-white background. At the center is a detailed, colored rendering of the bowl, which is round and has a scalloped interior. The inside of the bowl is orange-brown with darker brown and white highlights along the petal-like segments, while the outside is shaded in dark gray and brown tones. In the lower left corner, there is a line drawing showing a top-down view of the same bowl, outlining the scalloped pattern clearly with no color added. In the upper right corner, there is another outline showing the profile or side view of the bowl, depicting the same scalloped and textured interior. The drawing is signed "R. Stewart" in the lower right quadrant. The layout is organized with the colored bowl centrally positioned, and the two outlined versions in opposite corners for reference.
title: Pa. German Gelatin Mold
